scenario: [LNUL.8.4] a Json path resolving to a present `null` READS AS null, so `??` catches it. Drives the operator half of a pair: `??` short-circuits on DS_RETE_VAL_NULL alone, so a projection that returns a soft-fail marker for a null leaf makes `p.body.nulled ?? 7` yield the marker rather than 7, which contradicts `[LNUL.8.9]`. Pins the DS_JSON_NULL arm of `ds_rete_json_to_val` (rete/eval.c) — the ONE projection, reached from both the evaluator's json_path arm and builtins.c's. The second conjunct is the control and is not decoration: a projection that answered `null` for EVERY leaf would satisfy the first conjunct, and only a present non-null value distinguishes `??` working from `??` always defaulting. ONLY MEANINGFUL BESIDE LNUL.8.4b, which drives `is null` over the same document — the two operators read the marker differently, so either vector alone passes under a mistake that fixes the other.
rules_ds:
schema Payload scope logical:
    body: Json key

rule coalesce_reads_the_null_leaf:
    Payload p where (p.body.nulled ?? 7) == 7 and (p.body.five ?? 7) == 5
->
    log critical "coalesce-ok"
